prerequisites: EXPRESIÓN GRÁFICA Y DISEÑO ASISTIDO POR ORDENADOR II/20224002

learning_outcomes.text: Plans, executes, and interprets machine tests.
Uses software for calculating machine elements using the finite element method.
Designs mechanical assemblies with computer-aided tools.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Machine Design with Computer-aided Tools
Optimization and calculation of machine elements using the finite element method
teaching_methods: Introductory activities: Concept and method of computer-aided design
ICT-based practicals in computer labs: Case resolution with Fusion 360 software
Assignments: Completion of course assignments following Agile methodology
assessment_rules: To pass, a minimum grade of 3.5 out of 10 is required for each of the two continuous assessment components (practicals and assignments). The second attempt (resit) involves completing and defending an individual project with a scope similar to the main project. Fraudulent activity in any assessment will result in a failing grade for that activity.
